Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with the trachea and mediastinum shifted to the right (contralateral side), which indicates a space-occupying lesion such as a massive pleural effusion or pyopneumothorax pushing structures away, rather than volume loss from collapse which would pull them toward the opacity.
